name: flowgrid-project-state
description: A local JSONL command adapter for FlowGrid project-state workflows.

tools.name: initialize_project
tools.description: Initialize a local FlowGrid project ledger.

tools.name: save_session
tools.description: Persist a raw user-agent session before extraction.

tools.name: closeout_session
tools.description: Create a pending FlowGrid closeout patch from a saved session.

tools.name: review_decisions
tools.description: Review a pending patch. Demo mode uses explicit accept_all only.

tools.name: merge_patch
tools.description: Merge a reviewed patch into formal project state.

tools.name: resume_project
tools.description: Return the formal handoff context for a new agent session.
